customers.name: Enterprise Architect

careAbout: Reducing manual modeling and evidence collection work
Answering impact, dependency, and ownership questions quickly during change reviews

customers.name: Technology Risk / Security Governance Leader
customers.description: Owns technology risk visibility, control traceability, policy exceptions, audit readiness, resilience evidence, and AI governance posture.
careAbout: Knowing which critical applications and technologies carry unmanaged risk
Proving that architecture decisions follow policy and control requirements
Governing AI systems and agents without blocking responsible innovation
winsThem: Traceability from controls and policies to applications, technologies, capabilities, and decisions
Evidence vaults and decision ledgers that reduce audit preparation effort
AI governance readiness views tied to architecture and business context
theirFear: Architecture tools create diagrams but cannot prove control coverage
AI adoption spreads faster than governance can discover, assess, and monitor it
